You are an expert UI/UX developer. I need your help with a TypeScript webapp Im currently working on. It is a Piano practice log and repertoire management tool I have recently began working on. I have detected it currently has several UI issues in the activity Screen. We are working on my repository https://github.com/Santatecla-dev/PianoCompanion , and the commit Hash to check is ab99212. This repository and exact version is cloned here on the folder we are working. We have in C:\PianoCompanionDev\ the frontEnd and inside a folder called /backend/ we have obviously the backend. We are going to focus on the frontend unless you find any bugs that need the backend touched in order to get fixed. You can find screenshots of the bugs in C:\PianoCompanionDev\BugEvidence. All these issues are in the ActivityView.tsx.

Issue 1: As shown in C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-390.png and C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-milestones.png, the some elements cut on a narrow screen.

Issue 2: As shown in C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-day-panel.png, the selected-day card clips session editors, long titles, notes, and add-practice controls. The remaining content cannot be reached.

Issue 3: As shown in C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-checklist.png and C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-checklist-many.png, the practice checklist hides tasks when it grows. 

Issue 4: As shown in C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-pie-chart.png, the time-distribution pie chart and legend do not fit inside their card. 

Issue 5: As shown in C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-modal-390.png, the Add milestone dialog is too large for a small screen and its lower fields get cut. The dialog and growing checklist state also have unreliable keyboard focus and Escape behavior, as shown in C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-checklist-many.png.
Issue 6: As shown in C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-date-selection.png and C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-390.png, calendar selection, month rendering, insight totals, averages, and upcoming milestone counts are not consistently synchronized. The empty state shown in C:/PianoCompanionDev/BugEvidence/activity-empty-390.png also creates uneven spacing compared with the populated state.

I need you to fix these mentioned issues locally, without uploading to git (because I wanna check them locally before uploading anything) in the best way possible, keeping the functionality working, and I also would like you to find any other possible problems in this screen that I havent detected yet, but might impact performance, navigation or accessibility. Also, if you make any changes to styling or coloring, make sure all the app remains consistent.

+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises'
+
+// Mocked API and isolated storage keep the user's practice log untouched.
+const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: 'chrome', headless: true })
+const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, timezoneId: 'Europe/Madrid' })
+const page = await context.newPage()
+const errors = []
+page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message))
+const pieces = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `piece-${i}`, title: `Long piano composition ${i} ${'Variation'.repeat(10)}`, composer: 'Composer', difficulty: 'Intermediate', level: 'Intermediate', progress: 20, tone: 'lavender', symbol: 'P' }))
+let sessions = pieces.map((piece, i) => ({ id: `session-${i}`, piece, startedAt: '2026-09-25T10:00:00Z', durationSeconds: (i + 1) * 60, notes: 'Long practice notes. '.repeat(20) }))
+let milestones = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `milestone-${i}`, title: `Long preparation goal ${i} ${'Recital'.repeat(20)}`, date: `2026-09-${25 + i % 6}`, kind: 'concert', notes: 'Programme details '.repeat(12) }))
+let fail = false
+const requests = []
+await page.clock.install({ time: new Date('2026-09-25T12:00:00Z') })
+await page.route('http://localhost:3001/**', async route => {
+  const path = new URL(route.request().url()).pathname
+  const method = route.request().method()
+  if (method !== 'GET') {
+    const input = method === 'DELETE' ? {} : route.request().postDataJSON()
+    requests.push({ path, method, input })
+    if (fail) return route.fulfill({ status: 503, json: { message: 'Please retry' } })
+    if (method === 'PATCH') {
+      const id = path.split('/').at(-1)
+      sessions = sessions.map(s => s.id === id ? { ...s, ...input, startedAt: input.date ?? s.startedAt, piece: pieces.find(p => p.id === input.pieceId) ?? null } : s)
+      return route.fulfill({ json: sessions.find(s => s.id === id) })
+    }
+    if (method === 'POST' && path === '/practice/sessions') {
+      const saved = { ...input, id: 'new-session', startedAt: input.date, piece: pieces.find(p => p.id === input.pieceId) }
+      sessions.push(saved)
+      return route.fulfill({ json: saved })
+    }
+    if (method === 'POST' && path === '/milestones') {
+      const saved = { ...input, id: 'new-milestone' }
+      milestones.push(saved)
+      return route.fulfill({ json: saved })
+    }
+    if (method === 'DELETE') { sessions = sessions.filter(s => !path.endsWith(s.id)); milestones = milestones.filter(m => !path.endsWith(m.id)); return route.fulfill({ json: { deleted: true } }) }
+  }
+  return route.fulfill({ json: path === '/pieces' ? pieces : path === '/practice/sessions' ? sessions : path === '/milestones' ? milestones : {} })
+})
+await page.addInitScript(pieces => {
+  localStorage.setItem('piano-companion-user', JSON.stringify({ id: 'review', name: 'Activity Review', level: 'Intermediate' }))
+  localStorage.setItem('piano-companion-repertoire-version', '2')
+  localStorage.setItem('piano-companion-repertoire', JSON.stringify(pieces))
+  localStorage.setItem('piano-companion-activity-checklist', '{broken')
+}, pieces)
+await mkdir('BugEvidence/fixed-activity', { recursive: true })
+const total = () => page.locator('.insights-strip article').nth(0).locator('strong')
+const settle = () => page.waitForTimeout(100)
+try {
+  await page.goto('http://localhost:5173/#Activity')
+  await page.locator('.activity-session').first().waitFor()
+  assert.equal(await total().textContent(), '36')
+  assert.match(await page.locator('.insights-strip article').nth(1).textContent(), /5 min/)
+  assert.equal(await page.locator('.insights-strip article').nth(3).locator('strong').textContent(), '9')
+  assert.equal(await page.locator('.breakdown-card .extra-heading > span').textContent(), '36 min')
+  assert.equal(await page.locator('.pie-legend > div').count(), 6)
+  assert.match(await page.locator('.pie-legend').textContent(), /Other pieces/)
+  for (const width of [1440, 1100, 1024, 768, 681, 680, 390, 320]) {
+    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 844 })
+    assert(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), `Page overflow at ${width}`)
+    assert(await page.locator('.day-card, .practice-checklist, .breakdown-card, .milestone-list').evaluateAll(els => els.every(el => el.scrollWidth <= el.clientWidth + 1 && el.scrollHeight <= el.clientHeight + 1)), `Clipped card at ${width}`)
+    if ([390, 1440].includes(width)) await page.screenshot({ path: `BugEvidence/fixed-activity/activity-${width}.png`, fullPage: true })
+  }
+  const task = page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Add a practice task' })
+  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { await task.fill(`Extra task ${i} with a long description`); await task.press('Enter') }
+  assert.equal(await page.locator('.checklist-item').count(), 24)
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove Extra task 15 with a long description' }).click()
+  assert(await page.locator('.checklist-item input').last().evaluate(el => el === document.activeElement))
+  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
+  assert.equal(await page.locator('.checklist-item').count(), 23)
+  for (const viewport of [{ width: 390, height: 600 }, { width: 320, height: 480 }, { width: 844, height: 390 }]) {
+    await page.setViewportSize(viewport)
+    const opener = page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add milestone', exact: true })
+    await opener.click()
+    const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog')
+    assert(await dialog.evaluate(el => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.left >= 0 && r.right <= innerWidth && r.top >= 0 && r.bottom <= innerHeight && el.scrollWidth <= el.clientWidth }))
+    await dialog.getByLabel('What are you preparing for?').fill('A recital')
+    await dialog.getByLabel('Date', { exact: true }).fill('2027-01-03')
+    for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) { await page.keyboard.press(i % 2 ? 'Shift+Tab' : 'Tab'); assert(await dialog.evaluate(el => el.contains(document.activeElement))) }
+    await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save milestone' }).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
+    if (viewport.width === 390) await page.screenshot({ path: 'BugEvidence/fixed-activity/modal-390.png' })
+    await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
+    assert.equal(await dialog.count(), 0)
+    assert(await opener.evaluate(el => el === document.activeElement))
+    assert.match(await page.locator('.calendar-day.selected').getAttribute('aria-label'), /2026-09-25/)
+  }
+  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 })
+  assert.equal(await page.locator('.calendar-day:not(:disabled)').count(), 30)
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '2026-09-30,', exact: false }).click()
+  assert.match(await page.locator('.day-card h2').textContent(), /30/)
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next month' }).click()
+  assert.equal(await page.locator('.calendar-day:not(:disabled)').count(), 31)
+  assert.match(await page.locator('.calendar-day.selected').getAttribute('aria-label'), /2026-10-01/)
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous month' }).click()
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '2026-09-25,', exact: false }).click()
+  const editor = page.locator('.activity-session').first()
+  await editor.getByLabel('Minutes', { exact: true }).fill('1500')
+  assert(await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).isDisabled())
+  await editor.getByLabel('Minutes', { exact: true }).fill('10')
+  fail = true
+  await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).click()
+  await editor.getByRole('alert').waitFor()
+  assert(await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).isEnabled())
+  fail = false
+  await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).click()
+  await settle()
+  assert.equal(await total().textContent(), '45')
+  await editor.getByLabel('Date', { exact: true }).fill('2026-10-04')
+  await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).click()
+  await settle()
+  assert.match(await page.locator('.calendar-day.selected').getAttribute('aria-label'), /2026-10-04/)
+  assert.equal(requests.at(-1).input.date, '2026-10-04T10:00:00.000Z')
+  await page.getByLabel('Repertoire piece', { exact: true }).selectOption('piece-1')
+  await page.getByLabel('Practice minutes', { exact: true }).fill('15')
+  await page.locator('.add-session-box').getByRole('button', { name: 'Add', exact: true }).click()
+  await settle()
+  assert.equal(await total().textContent(), '60')
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '+ Add milestone', exact: true }).click()
+  await page.getByRole('dialog').getByLabel('Date', { exact: true }).fill('2026-10-04')
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save milestone' }).click()
+  await settle()
+  assert.equal(await page.getByRole('dialog').count(), 0)
+  assert.equal(await page.locator('.insights-strip article').nth(3).locator('strong').textContent(), '10')
+  await page.locator('.activity-session').first().getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete practice session' }).click()
+  await settle()
+  assert.equal(await total().textContent(), '45')
+  sessions = []; milestones = []
+  await page.reload()
+  await page.locator('.activity-empty').first().waitFor()
+  assert.equal(await total().textContent(), '0')
+  assert(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth))
+  await page.screenshot({ path: 'BugEvidence/fixed-activity/empty-390.png', fullPage: true })
+  assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
+  console.log('Activity checks passed: 8 widths, long content, checklist growth/focus, short dialogs/Escape, calendar dates, totals, CRUD, errors, and empty states.')
+} finally { await browser.close() }
*** End Patch"));
